cmd: cd /app/vendor && sha256sum -c sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz.sha256; tar tzf sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz | head; echo ---; which gcc make cc; gcc --version | head -1; make --version | head -1
cd /app && sha256sum -c /app/vendor/sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz.sha256; cat /etc/os-release | head -2; which apt-get; ls /usr/bin | grep -E '^(gcc|cc|clang|make)' | head
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -2 && apt-get install -y -qq gcc make libc6-dev 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /app && tar xzf vendor/sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz && ls /app/sqlite | head -30 && gcc --version | head -1 && make --version | head -1

ldconfig && which sqlite3 && sqlite3 --version && cd /tmp && rm -f /app/sqlite/*.gcda && echo "SELECT sqlite_version(), 1+1;" | sqlite3 && echo "CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, b TEXT); INSERT INTO t(b) VALUES('x'),('y'); SELECT count(*) FROM t;" | sqlite3 test.db && rm -f test.db && ls /app/sqlite/*.gcda | head -5 && ls /app/sqlite/*.gcda | wc -l
